title: pelma leptoleucum
intro: Pelma leptoleucum, commonly known as the 'Peruvian Apple Cactus', is a plant species that belongs to the Euphorbiaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can aid in the management of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Pelma leptoleucum include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce fever, and act as an anti-diarrheal agent. Bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins have been identified in the plant, contributing to its medicinal properties.
